briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.3%) with no strong risk-on signal to justify deploying capital. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 threshold anyway, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and waiting for a clearer setup.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' approach means holding back from new investments when market signals aren't strongly positive, even if it means sitting on cash. It's a deliberate choice to protect capital rather than chase mediocre setups, especially when you don't have enough conviction or capital to act meaningfully.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）指在市場訊號不夠強烈時，選擇不進行新投資,即使這意味著持有現金。這是一種主動保護資金的策略,而非追逐不夠明確的入市機會,尤其是在信心或資金皆不足以有效行動的情況下。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.2% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of major catalysts to push markets decisively in either direction. Trading stayed range-bound as investors awaited clearer economic or earnings signals. This kind of low-volatility session typically reflects a wait-and-see posture across the market rather than any specific news event.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和向上，納指上升0.2%，標普500指數上升0.3%，市場缺乏明顯催化劑推動方向性走勢。交投維持區間震盪，投資者仍在等待更清晰的經濟數據或業績訊號。這種低波動的交易日通常反映市場觀望氣氛,而非受特定新聞事件驅動。
